Element formation depends on the theater. In an urban setting, where (small) buildings are being cleared, yeah, they'll move by team, building to building. But in that setting, there is very limited use for a SAW. Clearing a building requires precision and agility. Plus you have plenty of cover already built in.

The point of a squad weapon is to provide cover where there is limited environmental cover available - or as a force multiplier.

Makes me wonder why the Army doesn't want the M27 then. It would allow every squad to have three or four guys armed with rifles in between an M4 and M249 with M4 weight just 2 inches longer barrel and a slight improvement in accuracy.
